entries.name: Pedestrian
entries.description: Person walking on or beside the carriageway.

entries.name: Child pedestrian
entries.description: Child on or near the road; unpredictable movement.

entries.name: Cyclist
entries.description: Bicycle rider sharing the lane.

entries.name: Motorcycle
entries.description: Motorcycle or scooter nearby, often filtering between lanes.

entries.name: Wrong-way motorcycle
entries.description: Two-wheeler travelling against the flow of traffic.

entries.name: Wrong-way car
entries.description: Car travelling against the flow of traffic.

entries.name: Stopped car
entries.description: Car stationary in a live lane.

entries.name: Stopped bus
entries.description: Bus stationary in a lane, often with boarding passengers.

entries.name: Stopped truck
entries.description: Truck parked or stopped on the carriageway, a frequent night hazard.

entries.name: Slow-moving vehicle
entries.description: Vehicle travelling far below the traffic speed.

entries.name: Tractor
entries.description: Tractor or tractor-trailer, often unlit.

entries.name: Animal
entries.description: Unspecified animal on or near the road.

entries.name: Cow
entries.description: Cow standing or walking on the road.

entries.name: Buffalo
entries.description: Buffalo on the road; dark colour makes it hard to see at night.

entries.name: Dog
entries.description: Dog crossing or chasing vehicles.

entries.name: Goat
entries.description: Goat or sheep on the road.

entries.name: Animal herd
entries.description: Herd of animals occupying the carriageway.

entries.name: Sudden braking vehicle
entries.description: Vehicle ahead braking hard.

entries.name: Opening vehicle door
entries.description: Door of a parked vehicle opening into the traffic lane.

entries.name: Reversing vehicle
entries.description: Vehicle reversing on or onto the road.

entries.name: Vehicle breakdown
entries.description: Broken-down vehicle with or without warning triangle.

entries.name: Accident scene
entries.description: Collision site with stopped vehicles and people on the road.

entries.name: Emergency vehicle
entries.description: Ambulance, fire or police vehicle approaching with priority.

entries.name: Bus stopping unexpectedly
entries.description: Bus pulling over or stopping mid-lane to pick up passengers.

entries.name: Traffic queue
entries.description: Stationary or slow queue ahead.
